goal: Hamburger sidebar on the map: name-only search with results, Pinned, Bookmarks, tag Filters with mini search
summary: The top FilterBar and the separate BookmarksPane are replaced by one left sidebar (components/map/MapSidebar.tsx) behind a hamburger in the top bar. Top: search that matches only person and bubble names (lib/client/filters.ts searchMatches no longer matches tags or bookmark names), with a results dropdown (Bubbles / People, match highlighted). Typing keeps Nobel's behaviour (highlight + pull matches to the middle, camera still); picking a result (click or Enter) narrows the highlight to that one bubble/person, glides the camera there with the new MapApi.centerOn (aims at the layout anchor, offset for the sidebar), and opens a person's profile card. Pinned: bubbles you pinned from the double-click popup (AddToBookmark now has a Pin row); click enters, pin icon unpins. Bookmarks: the old pane's content as BookmarksSection; clicking a bookmark toggles 'show only these bubbles'. Filters: the 10 category tags as plain on/off checkboxes with All/None, plus a mini tag search whose popup shows a check on the right of ticked tags. The four-state chips (on/off/exclude/none) and bookmark chips are gone.

decisions.what: Pins live in the user's bookmarks JSON as a reserved entry id '__pinned__' (hooks/useBookmarks.ts PINNED_ID), hidden from every bookmark list.
decisions.why: No schema change or migration on the shared Oracle DB; the existing PATCH /api/users/:id bookmarks path and zod schema already accept it.

decisions.what: Tag filters are binary (unchecked tags hide bubbles); the exclude state and bookmark chips were dropped.
decisions.why: Requested simple select/deselect; bookmarks have their own section and narrow the map from there.

decisions.what: centerOn aims at layout.current.anchors, called 60ms after the pick.
decisions.why: A picked bubble becomes a search match, and computeLayout(priority) moves it to the middle; aiming at its drawn position glided to where it used to be.

verification.manual: next dev (in-memory world), dark theme, 1024x768: opened menu, searched 'ch'/'badm' (results + highlight), picked bubble and person (camera + profile card), pinned via double-click popup, created bookmark, ticked/unticked tags via mini search popup; bookmark/pin PATCH 200. Light theme and mobile width not checked.

next_steps: Check the sidebar in light theme and at phone width (sidebar is 300px, max calc(100vw-24px)).
Open a PR from feat/map-sidebar to main.
